test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 02 Dec 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

Technology plays an __indispensable__ role in the lives of human beings in the 21st century.
solution: The correct answer is: **Superfluous** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Indispensable**: Incapable of being disregarded or neglected. (अपरिहार्य; उपेक्षित या उपेक्षित होने में असमर्थ) • Let us look at the **meaning **of the words given in the options section. • **Superfluous**: Unnecessary, especially through being more than enough. (ज़रूरत से ज़्यादा; अनावश्यक, विशेष रूप से पर्याप्त से अधिक होने के कारण) • **Relentless**: Something that is harsh, unforgiving, and persistent. (कुछ ऐसा जो कठोर, अक्षम्य और लगातार बना रहे; दयाहीन) • Vigilant: Keeping careful watch for possible danger or difficulties. (चौकस) • **Transparent**: easy to perceive or detect; (of a material or article) allowing light to pass through so that objects behind can be distinctly seen. (पारदर्शी) • From the meaning of the given words, it is clear that the most appropriate antonym of '**Indispensable**' is '**Superfluous**'. • Therefore, the correct answer is option 1. 1e5:T927, The correct answer is: **clouding**
